items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: My Uncle Paul had introduced me to Willie Smith, the Lion -- Paul Barbarin. He introduced me to him.

ctx.x: It was in the basement. Later it was Dickie Wells' club. On the ground floor, there was another club overhead called The Mad House. That's the first place I saw Billie Holiday. And opposite the Nest, facing the Nest was Pa's(?) and Jerry's, which is the club where Willie Smith, the Lion, worked for many years.
